description: Drupal administration pages (Claro theme, with the Navigation sidebar in Drupal 11.3 and later or the classic toolbar before it). Signs in at /user/login with DRUPAL_USER and DRUPAL_PASSWORD from the environment, for a local or test site; for a hosted site with SSO, set "signIn": "chrome" in the config and sign in yourself in the dedicated Chrome. Hides status messages so a leftover "saved" message doesn't end up in a shot. Selectors checked against Drupal 11.4 on 2026-10-08.
